runtime: Isaac Sim 6.0.1 experimental with exact project-specific IsaacLab source, not official runtime equivalence

T01.title: 端托盘行走，同时抵抗物体与身体推扰
T01.observation: Original noisy policy history and encoder object/tray history including delays; critic excluded. Not RGB-only.
T01.action: Original full-body joint position targets using G1_DELAY_ACTION_SCALE and default offsets; no author residual runner or pretrained locomotion policy.
T01.scoring: Native reward/termination and command tracking errors; no official binary walking SR. Separately report RobotWorld-derived full-20s raw-failure-free completion and strict object retention. Neither alone proves walking command following.
T01.scoring_kind: RobotWorld-derived strict failure-free completion reported separately from native reward/tracking metrics
